visualReview.notes: Compared the open three-sided court, pink plaster arcades, roof balustrades, terraced garden, tiled east roof and the Searing Wing’s square opening against the cleared photographs and federal survey. The courtyard approach and roof close views retain genuine open arches and sky aperture.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected the placed lime plaster, pale limestone, terracotta tile, gray roof, dark-green Chao pavilion and simplified sculpture surfaces.

mediumFiReview.notes: The three wings, courtyard and both attached additions read at the four runtime distances. Close views show the filled terraced parterre, arcade depth, east entrance and open Searing roof.

terrain.grade: The measured east promenade datum is 5.0989 m NAVD88. Source USGS 3DEP samples range from 1.7073 to 6.5506 m over 282 m. The model supplies the terraced courtyard surface below the loggias and preserves the original ground beyond it.

geographicReview.notes: The named OpenStreetMap gallery and Searing perimeter establish the placement at the museum itself. The native roof survey independently confirms the principal axes and court. Placement removed the duplicate terrain inside the constructed parterre and restored it on unload.

fidelityReview.scope: The standing Museum of Art’s three Italian Renaissance gallery ranges and open stepped courtyard, with the attached Searing and Chao wings.
fidelityReview.notes: Named footprint and federal aerial survey establish building and garden positions. Local heights, most secondary exterior openings, simplified sculptures and the Chao rainscreen are approximations. The model covers the architecture of the galleries and court.

imageryReview.notes: Started with the exact native CC0 atrium photograph in Qualla. Verified also Daderot’s 2017 exact courtyard original and uploader dedication. Used the public-domain USDA imagery as overhead geometry evidence.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Reviewed the current exterior, shared-material renders, four detail levels, the fitted courtyard and the unmodified ground.

limitations: Draft exterior: approximate photographic proportions and simplified ornament. It is not a survey, photogrammetric reconstruction or approved current geographic replacement.

The verified Qualla atrium photo establishes the Searing Wing’s square open aperture. Daderot’s dedicated courtyard original establishes the pink plaster loggias, roof balustrades and stepped court. National Register documentation describes the rusticated east entry.
Terrain sampling/contact, geographic alignment and site activation remain pending. Runtime LODs are produced by the registered after-import pipeline and require visual review.
Reference photos remain in the local Qualla corpus; only provenance, paths and hashes are retained here.
